title: Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) Policy & Guidelines

nodes.title: 1. Programme Overview & Type
nodes.content:
Programme Name: Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA)
Jurisdiction: India
Category: Digital health identity
Type: Digital Health Identity
Details: Digital health account identifier to help individuals link and manage records in participating digital health services. It is not insurance and does not itself guarantee free treatment.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria & Conditions
nodes.content:
Eligibility: Individuals can create an ABHA under current ABDM registration rules; record linking is subject to participation and consent.
Individual Enrolment Required: False

nodes.title: 3. Required Documents & Documentation
nodes.content: Required Documents: Aadhaar or another supported identity/verification method, depending on current creation flow.

nodes.title: 4. Application Procedure & Access Desks
nodes.content:
Where to Apply / Access: Use the official ABHA/ABDM portal or supported health applications and facilities.
Official Portal: https://abha.abdm.gov.in/
